answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 64 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a voyage bet on surviving 64 epochs of grading, and every comet settlement recomputes the terrace schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 11 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
